requirements: English, per AGENTS.md engineering-output language law.
Every changed public type names the clause (14D CF-n/PR-n, 14E PF-n/PM-n/PP-n, C4 section n).
Do NOT use './ui2/gradlew -p ui2 build' without '-x :integration-tests:test'. Do not run the full Python pytest suite. Eleven Gradle subprojects. Migration V15 only, additive.
No estate value anywhere; fixtures use documentation addresses and invented names.
If a contract clause and this packet disagree, raise a RELAY_QUESTION and STOP; never relax a direction or closed-set test.
No emoji, no tool-identifying footer, no external URL in commits, the PR or code comments.
Open the PR at the end; do not merge. SESSION_CLOSE names the gate entries count per vendor, the maturity/sign-off values chosen and why, the parser changes, and test counts before and after.
risks: Seeding gate rows in any state other than SIGNED_OFF makes the capability ineligible by C4 design -- the decision is recorded; do not ask again.
Choosing a maturity state the admission or claim path rejects -- read both call sites before choosing.
Canonical key mismatch between YAML step and gate row -> silently ineligible; the resolver test is the guard.
Keeping the &vsys forms in the plan after 14E dropped them.
Mapping every unknown flag letter to static.
